implementationProposals.proposal: Attach bounded evidence from already-received successful-HTTP responses to parsing/extraction exceptions: final/requested URL, status, type, byte count, raw hash, selector/candidate diagnostics and capped body preview. Write per-source failure evidence JSON independently of RAW_DIRECTORY. Preserve the failed observation and prior good baseline; do not perform a diagnostic refetch.

Persist bounded allowlisted error cause/AggregateError details and per-attempt phase/start/end/elapsed. Keep errors behind fetch failed distinguishable before changing transport/retry behavior. Never dump arbitrary objects, credentials, cookies, proxy configuration or environment.

Retain sanitized redirect history and the URL-validation rejection reason/attempted URL components. Do not relax public HTTPS, DNS, private-address, credential, port or TLS guards. Minnesota exact failing hop remains unproven.

Make missing-resource/error-page diagnostics distinct from access/security blocks, retaining original HTTP status/body and a failed result. Texas FAQ HTTP403 has an explicit missing-file body, not a browser challenge.

Recognize the observed explicit CloudFront/Cloudflare denial signatures for accurate diagnostic flags. Consider retaining a same-URL explicit nonretryable denial in a per-run negative cache so a second source ID does not request the identical blocked URL again; preserve separate failure records for both IDs. This is not permission to cycle endpoints or identities.

After instrumentation, one bounded ordinary hosted replay of the four unreadable sources with raw evidence enabled can distinguish body versus extraction failure. Stop on access restriction. No broad rerun, content relaxation, automatic issue resolution or substantive-date advance is justified by this audit.

notJustified: Security/access bypass, user-agent or proxy identity cycling, TLS disabling, IP hardcoding or DNS/SSRF guard relaxation.
Declaring the 12 generic transport failures TLS/DNS/timeouts from timing or a different environment follow-up.
Declaring the 4 original unreadable failures empty pages, JS shells or parser defects from later successful managed-proxy bodies.
Switching legal sources or changing interpretations from search snippets, or treating the known Texas same-host GetStatute API as a proven hosted transport repair.
Resolving failures or advancing substantiveVerifiedAt because a separate follow-up fetch succeeded.
